findings.title: Registered metric-alert handler is now abstract and cannot be instantiated
findings.body: `MetricAlertDetectorHandler` inherits `StatefulDetectorHandler` but implements none of its abstract requirements (`counter_names`, `get_dedupe_value`, `get_group_key_values`, or `build_occurrence_and_event_data`). `Detector.detector_handler` instantiates the configured handler directly, so processing any detector whose type is `metric_alert_fire` now raises `TypeError` before evaluation. Previously this handler was concrete and safely returned no results. Implement the stateful methods or do not register this class as the group type's handler until an implementation exists.

findings.title: Stateful detector evaluation documentation still describes the old list API
findings.body: The `StatefulDetectorHandler.evaluate` docstring says it returns a list of `DetectorEvaluationResult`, while the method now returns a dictionary keyed by group key. This is the extension contract detector implementations must follow; an implementation following the docstring will return a list and `process_detectors` will fail when it calls `.values()`. Update the documentation to describe the dictionary result and its key invariant.

findings.title: Multi-group occurrence test does not verify the value passed to the new hook
findings.body: The input gives `group_2` the value `10`, but the expected occurrence is built with `6`; moreover, `build_mock_occurrence_and_event` ignores its `value` argument. Consequently, this test would still pass if evaluation incorrectly passed the first group's value to every `build_occurrence_and_event_data` call. Make the test helper consume the value or mock and assert the hook's arguments, including `10` for `group_2`.
